Subtract 260 days from 1887-11-10.  
1887 is not a leap year.  
From 1887-11-10 back 260 days:  
First go back 10 days to 1887-10-31.  
Then back 250 more days:  
October has 31 days, so back 31 to Sep 30 → 219 left.  
September has 30 → back 30 to Aug 31 → 189 left.  
August has 31 → back 31 to July 31 → 158 left.  
July has 31 → back 31 to June 30 → 127 left.  
June has 30 → back 30 to May 31 → 97 left.  
May has 31 → back 31 to April 30 → 66 left.  
April has 30 → back 30 to March 31 → 36 left.  
March has 31 → back 31 to February 28 (1887 not leap) → 5 left.  
Back 5 more days from 1887-02-28 → 1887-02-23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1887-02-23
